_comment: Per-logo settings for build_collected_display.py, keyed by collected asset id. facing: the share of a faint shape's edge that must meet the page for it to be redrawn (default 0.5; higher keeps more of a logo's own colours). light / dark: false keeps the file's own colours on that ground; "plate" shows them on a light plate of their own there. light-palette / dark-palette: {"#source": "#shown"} maps the file's colours by hand for that ground (every key must be a colour the file uses). "all" for light / dark redraws every colour too faint for that ground, without the test of whether it meets the page (for lettering drawn letter by letter in clipped fills). skip: true leaves the file out. light-css / dark-css: a selector-specific rule applied to the display copy for that theme. preserve-canvas: keep the full page of a stationery specimen.
